scope: Rendered local xMind browser acceptance using an isolated native profile and two disposable folders. No TestProj profile or files were used.
checks: Configure Workspace reported that switching is unavailable while only one workspace is registered.
Created a new workspace from folder-b; the dialog selected it and showed its primary folder.
After closing the dialog, the page showed folder-b as current and rendered B_ONLY.md.
Switched the registered workspace to folder-a; the page rendered A_ONLY.md.
Reloaded the page and reconnected to the same local profile; folder-a remained selected and A_ONLY.md remained visible.
provider_key: not configured or required for workspace switching
limitations: This verifies rendered local browser workspace selection, file-explorer refresh, and persistence across page reload.
It does not verify model inference or the VS Code extension workspace selector.
